scripts.text:
[Han]
There must be a ton of monsters
attacking the center of Prontera.
***
scripts.translation:
[韩]
普隆德拉中心一定正遭到大量魔物的袭击。
***

scripts.text:
[Han]
My family...My friends...
They're all there...
I must protect them...
But...I have an even more important
job to do here...
scripts.translation:
[韩]
我的家人...我的朋友们...
他们都在那里...
我必须保护他们...
但是...我在这里还有更重要的任务...

scripts.text:
[Han]
I, scientist Doyeon, can do it.
I can obliterate that dirty source place,
ceaselessly spawning the monsters...
That's why I'm protecting him.
***
scripts.translation:
[韩]
我，科学家道渊，能做到。
我可以摧毁那个肮脏的源头，
那个不断生成魔物的地方...
这就是为什么我要保护他。
***

scripts.text:
[Han]
Protecting him and destroying this fortress
is what ultimately protects my family
and friends.
scripts.translation:
[韩]
保护他并摧毁这座要塞，
最终才能保护我的家人和朋友。

scripts.text:
[Doek]
Can this scientist you're seeing here
really protect Prontera?
Can she?
Do you believe so?
scripts.translation:
[德克]
你看到的这位科学家，
真的能保护普隆德拉吗？
她真的可以吗？
你相信吗？

scripts.text:
[Doek]
Honestly, I don't...
But...
scripts.translation:
[德克]
说实话，我不太相信...
但是...

scripts.text:
[Doek]
All my loved ones were...
...by those monsters....
scripts.translation:
[德克]
我所有的亲人都...
...被那些魔物夺走了....

scripts.text:
[Doek]
This is the last hope I can have...
This is the last.
So please help me.
Help Doyeon...
scripts.translation:
[德克]
这是我最后的希望...
这是最后的机会。
所以请帮帮我。
帮帮道渊...

scripts.text:
- And then, she remained silent -
- for quite a while. -
scripts.translation:
- 然后，她沉默了 -
- 许久。 -

scripts.text:
- It's full of items
so you can't proceed to conversation. -
scripts.translation: - 你的物品栏已满，无法继续对话。 -

scripts.text:
- You should be level 145 or higher
to proceed. -
scripts.translation: - 你需要达到145级才能继续。 -

scripts.text:
[Scientist Doyeon]
I'm a scientist
living in Prontera.
I'm just an ordinary scientist
teaching children and doing research.
And then...things came up
in Prontera all of a sudden....
scripts.translation:
[科学家 道渊]
我是住在普隆德拉的科学家。
我只是一个普通的科学家，
教孩子们知识并做研究。
然后...普隆德拉突然发生了变故....

scripts.text:
[Scientist Doyeon]

living in Prontera.

teaching children and doing research.

in Prontera all of a sudden....
You're back unscathed.

inside?
scripts.translation:
[科学家 道渊]

你毫发无伤地回来了。

scripts.text: Enter the Sky Fortress.

[Scientist Doyeon]
I think I can open the warp,
at least for once, with the magic
that I've been collecting so hard.
I hope you would help me
destroy the fortress and
get back our Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[科学家 道渊]
我想我可以打开传送门，
至少一次，用我辛苦收集的魔力。
我希望你能帮我摧毁要塞，
夺回我们的普隆德拉。

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

[Scientist Doyeon]
Come back
if you change your mind...
Just know that time is running out...
You're back unscathed.
So...whatever happened
inside?
scripts.translation:
[科学家 道渊]
如果你改变主意，
随时可以回来...
但要知道时间不多了...
你毫发无伤地回来了。
那么...里面发生了什么？

to the Sky Fortress!

传送门只会在有限时间内激活。

scripts.text:
[Scientist Doyeon]
I'm so worried about
the future of Prontera...
It appears this fortress
must be the source of all evil...
scripts.translation:
[科学家 道渊]
我很担心普隆德拉的未来...
看来这座要塞
是一切邪恶的源头...

scripts.text:

inside?
scripts.translation:

happened inside the Sky Fortress. -
scripts.translation: - 我把在天空要塞内部发生的一切都告诉了她。 -

[Scientist Doyeon]
How could that be...
Still, I think we have every reason to remain hopeful
for eliminating that huge Golem
in the Sky Fortress.
scripts.translation:

不过，我认为我们仍有理由保持希望，

scripts.text:
[Scientist Doyeon]
Still, those filthy monsters
keep spawning in Prontera.
So I think what we've done
must not be enough.
***
scripts.translation:
[科学家 道渊]
但是，那些肮脏的魔物
还在普隆德拉不断生成。
所以我觉得我们做的还不够。
***

a lot of magic is required.

three days to collect magic.

our village has turned into a trash heap

and bring peace to Prontera.

现在，我需要一位勇士，
去粉碎那座要塞，
为普隆德拉带来和平。

但那里变得太危险了，
所以我搬到了这里。

scripts.text: About Sky Fortress
scripts.translation: 关于天空要塞

scripts.text: Enter the Sky Fortress.
scripts.translation: 进入天空要塞

scripts.text: End the dialogue.
scripts.translation: 结束对话

scripts.text:
[Scientist Doyeon]
But now...my normal life
has become shattered.
scripts.translation:
[科学家 道渊]
但现在...我原本的生活
已经支离破碎了。

scripts.text:
[Scientist Doyeon]
Thanks to this fortress
looking like a huge trash can,
our village has turned into a trash heap
that doesn't even decay.
scripts.translation:
[科学家 道渊]
多亏了这座看起来像巨大垃圾桶的要塞，
我们的村庄变成了一个
连腐烂都不肯的垃圾堆。

scripts.text:
[Scientist Doyeon]
Buildings fall down,
people keep dying out...
I have to wonder what the nobility and soldiers at the Prontera Palace
are up to when things are like this.
scripts.translation:
[科学家 道渊]
建筑物倒塌，
人们不断死亡...
我不禁想知道，在这样的时候，
普隆德拉宫殿里的贵族和士兵们在做什么。

scripts.text:
[Scientist Doyeon]
A ton of undead monsters kept swarming about
as if the sap monster spits out the sap.
They kept coming out
no matter how many were killed.
***
scripts.translation:
[科学家 道渊]
大量的不死系魔物
就像树液怪吐出树液一样涌出来。
无论杀了多少，它们都源源不断地出现。
***

scripts.text:
[Scientist Doyeon]
I suppose the monsters are being made up
inside the fortress.
My guess is that if we can defeat their ringleader in the fortress,
the monsters will go away
and Prontera will become stabilized.
***
scripts.translation:
[科学家 道渊]
我想魔物是在要塞内部生成的。
我猜测，如果我们能击败要塞里的头目，
魔物就会消失，
普隆德拉也会恢复稳定。
***

scripts.text:
[Scientist Doyeon]
So I wanted to enter the fortress
but couldn't find any entrance.
I studied day and night
and finally located it.
scripts.translation:
[科学家 道渊]
所以我想进入要塞，
但一直找不到入口。
我日夜研究，
终于找到了它。

scripts.text:
[Scientist Doyeon]
To enter the fortress,
the warp should be activated.
To do so, a lot of magic
is indispensable!
scripts.translation:
[科学家 道渊]
要进入要塞，
必须激活传送门。
为此，
大量的魔法是必不可少的！

scripts.text:
[Scientist Doyeon]
And then...I've been preparing
a lot of magic necessary for the warp.
Now I could use a warrior
who can shatter the fortress
and bring peace to Prontera.
That's why I'm here.
scripts.translation:
[科学家 道渊]
然后...我一直在准备
激活传送门所需的魔法。
现在，我需要一位勇士，
去粉碎那座要塞，
为普隆德拉带来和平。
这就是我在这里的原因。

scripts.text:
[Scientist Doyeon]
To operate the warp,
a lot of magic is required.
Don't forget to bring me
the -Dungeon Pass-.
That's the only way to open
the warp to the Sky Fortress.
scripts.translation:
[科学家 道渊]
要操作传送门，
需要大量的魔法。
别忘了给我
-地下城通行证-。
这是打开通往天空要塞传送门的唯一方法。

scripts.text: End the dialogue.
scripts.translation: 结束对话

scripts.text: Show the -Dungeon Pass-.
scripts.translation: 出示“地下城通行证”。

scripts.text:
[Scientist Doyeon]
Don't forget to bring me
the -Dungeon Pass-.
Enter the Sky Fortress
and help us save
the invaded Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[科学家 道渊]
别忘了给我
-地下城通行证-。
进入天空要塞，
帮助我们拯救
被侵略的普隆德拉。

scripts.text:
[Scientist Doyeon]
I don't think this works
without the -Dungeon Pass-.
I can't open the warp without it.
scripts.translation:
[科学家 道渊]
没有“地下城通行证”，
我觉得这行不通。
没有它，我无法打开传送门。

scripts.text:
[Scientist Doyeon]
Oh! Where did you
get the -Dungeon Pass-?
This item is enough
to open the warp.
scripts.translation:
[科学家 道渊]
哦！你从哪里
弄到了-地下城通行证-？
只要有这个，
就足以打开传送门了。

scripts.text: End the dialogue.
scripts.translation: 结束对话

scripts.text: Activate the warp.
scripts.translation: 启动传送门。

scripts.text:
[Scientist Doyeon]
Are you not going
to help Prontera?
scripts.translation:
[科学家 道渊]
你不想帮助普隆德拉吗？

to the Sky Fortress!
The warp will be activated
only for a limited period of time.
Step inside it, quick!
